activities.title: Mysore Palace
activities.description: Guided tour of the historic Mysore Palace, exploring its grand halls, artwork, and royal history.

activities.title: St. Philomena's Cathedral
activities.description: Visit the neo‑Gothic cathedral, admire its stained‑glass windows and serene interior.

activities.title: Lunch at a local restaurant
activities.description: Enjoy a traditional Mysore thali or popular dishes such as Mysore masala dosa at a reputable local eatery.

activities.title: Sri Chamarajendra Zoological Gardens (Mysore Zoo)
activities.description: Explore one of India's oldest zoos, spotting native wildlife and the famed white tiger.

activities.title: Chamundi Hill & Temple
activities.description: Climb (or take a short auto‑rickshaw ride) to Chamundi Hill, visit the temple and enjoy panoramic city views.

activities.title: Brindavan Gardens
activities.description: Stroll through the illuminated gardens, watch the musical fountain show and relax by the lake.

activities.title: Return to starting point
activities.description: Travel back to the hotel or drop‑off location, concluding the day trip.
